subject: Compute final schema/SRT implementation + passing host suites (ACK requested)
body:
Implemented the negotiated schema changes and the SRT count wrapper; fresh host results below. No compiler implementation, native build, device, publish or commit.

CODE NOW MATCHES THE PROPOSED SCHEMA
- pipeline_format.h: manifest words9..11 are reserved_view[3] and must be zero; storage_format canonical Vk only for IMAGE (42-value map, numeric class checked); named DIM_/NUMERIC_ domains with array/MS/Buffer/depth rules; record flags bit0 dummy, bit1 declared-combined, bit2 sampler-compare; only a flagged TEX+SAM pair may share a binding; all other cross-table/same-binding collisions and orphan flags refuse; access rules UBO READ / TEXTURE READ|SAMPLE / SAMPLER 0 / SSBO READ/WRITE(+ATOMIC only with both) / IMAGE STORAGE+READ/WRITE(+ATOMIC only with both, no SAMPLE).
- wire/manifest matching enforces declared-combined and sampler-compare flags, exact Vk image format (unknown storage still requires a nonzero runtime Vk view), numeric class for IMAGE, and all prior table/entry/access checks. Atomic wire flags still refuse explicitly until atomic memory semantics/write tracking exist.
- arch9 SRT: additive `n2mb_compute_srt_pointer` validates 64-byte address, entries multiple-of-4 in [4,60], and full span, then encodes `(address&~63)|4`; v1 keeps resources0. The shared JM builder still validates the 64-aligned base, then the bridge writes the count-bearing word to the shader-environment resources field only after wrapper validation. Host test decodes address+count and refuses count3/64/misalignment/short span. Root may replace the wrapper with a shared count-aware builder; it is isolated.
- n2mb_draw_v2 additive symbol for render is implemented and null-refusal tested; old n2mb_draw bytes unchanged.

TESTS (current source)
- `python3 workers/compute/check_compute_v2.py`: release + ASan/UBSan PASS. Covers TGP1 regression, TGP2 code_offset import, manifest/flags/collision/access/shape/format refusals, SRT count, tables1/2/dummy, nonzero base, 2-layer planes, native sampler31, combined/compare mismatches, numeric mismatch, atomic refusal, draw_v2 symbol.
- Rust full suite: 20/20 PASS (ABI line unchanged: r=160 d=64 reg=1172 v=11496 vh=36 desc=72 regions=2120; real TestFastMath sampled+sampler, exact-thread regions, accumulateKernel bound-format variant).
- ARM64 freestanding compile PASS compute_frontend+bridge. Frontend v1 host path PASS with final cdylib 4bad3821....
- Final hashes in workers/compute/STATUS.md: pipeline_format.h 85d28f32..., air_bridge.rs f83ed62f..., bridge.c 52f00fec..., bridge.h 71a874c1..., compute_frontend.m 3bdcdc4f..., runtime_pipeline.inc 5c9c46dc....

REMAINING BLOCKER: tegu_mali_compile_compute_v2. Until lowering implements and root scopes it, texture/image/sampler dispatch explicitly refuses (legacy TGP1 refusal or no v2 symbol). Full mip wire, >16 layers, atomic transport and startup exact-sampler policy remain explicitly limited. Please ACK the schema and re-run the integration probe; I will make no further shared-interface changes silently.
